title: Check a response field
summary: A body check should use the contract for that request. Read JSON and assert the field you need.
introduction: A body check should use the contract for that request. Read JSON and assert the field you need. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A body check should use the contract for that request. Read JSON and assert the field you need.

blocks.title: Check a response field

blocks.text: For a documented JSON book response, the test checks that title is a string. A non-JSON body makes parsing fail.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a check that pages is a number.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not parse every response as JSON without checking the endpoint's contract.
For more detail later, use this [Postman further reading](https://learning.postman.com/docs/getting-started/overview/).
